gui.binoscombat.combos.title: Combo list
gui.binoscombat.combos.need_weapon: Hold a sword or an axe to see your character perform the combo.
gui.binoscombat.combos.base.desc: Five light attacks in a row. The fifth ends the combo.
gui.binoscombat.combos.tormenta.desc: Four lights and the heavy. The strongest finisher; hold heavy to charge (4 levels).
gui.binoscombat.combos.judgment.desc: Three lights and the heavy: leap and strike down.
gui.binoscombat.combos.guard_break.desc: Two lights and the heavy: fills a lot of enemy posture.
gui.binoscombat.combos.surprise.desc: One light and the heavy: quick forward thrust.
gui.binoscombat.combos.meteor.desc: In the air, lights keep the enemy airborne; the heavy ends with a dive.
gui.binoscombat.combos.launcher.desc: Crouching (Shift), the heavy always launches the enemy. Launching gives back 40 stamina.
gui.binoscombat.combos.dash.desc: Double-tap W to dash; right after, light = dash slash.
gui.binoscombat.combos.pierce.desc: Right after the dash, the heavy pierces ahead.
gui.binoscombat.combos.roll.desc: Q to roll; right after, light = slash, heavy = thrust.
gui.binoscombat.combos.forward.desc: While sprinting, the attack carries your body forward.
gui.binoscombat.combos.parry.desc: R right on the hit (white blocks, yellow stuns, blue = Issen). Hold R to block (up to 2 s).
gui.binoscombat.combos.issen.desc: A blue parry triggers an Issen. Then another chance appears: left click on time to chain another. If the Issen kills and another enemy is in sight, you warp to it and strike again, stronger each time.
gui.binoscombat.combos.backstab.desc: Crouching, behind an enemy that hasn't seen you.
gui.binoscombat.combos.critical.desc: Heavy near an enemy with a broken guard (kneeling).
message.binoscombat.guard_need_weapon: Defend needs a sword, an axe or a shield
